name: Grade Analyzer
requirements: Accept an int[] containing test scores.
Count how many scores are passing (>= 65).
Count how many scores are failing (< 65).
Use an enhanced for loop for at least one calculation.
Return all information as one formatted String.
Handle an empty array without crashing.
Independently calculate the expected results in the test code.
Use if/else to compare the actual result against the expected result.
Print "Correct!" if the result is correct.
Print "Incorrect!" if the result is incorrect.
